pending.name: Caraboo
pending.announcedFrom: Official Awakener Overview + Skills/Enlighten infographics, plus the follow-up Supplementary Notice
pending.realmRewriteNote: Eden of Propagation — 'When Caraboo is in the team, the Caro Realm is tricked into becoming Propagation: Caro.' This is the SAME rewrite Saya brings, which makes her the first case of two characters sharing one rewrite. Everything already adjudicated about Propagation: Caro applies to her: the raised Embryo Fusion threshold, the loss of first-Devour shield/STR in favour of Propagation Fiesta stacks, and therefore the Saya/Sorel anti-synergy (Sorel's Infinite Devour scales with embryo count). Expect Caraboo/Sorel to be a bad pairing for the same reason, and expect Caraboo and Saya to be redundant rather than additive on one team.

talents.Eden of Propagation: When Caraboo is in the team, the Caro Realm is tricked into becoming Propagation: Caro.
talents.Soulforge Aptitude: Exalt's Crit. Rate and Crit. DMG +5%~50%. Satiety Max HP bonus (see correction below). In the 'Icefields' terrain: 'Snowy Hex' Arithmetica Cost -1; DMG hits count +1; deal DMG to and inflict Weakness on all enemies.

skills.Exalt — Ta-da\u2605It's the Fairy!: [Devour: Gain 'Satiety'. Upon dealing DMG, inflict 2592 stacks of Corrosion on the target.] Dispel Burn from all cards in hand. Gain 135 Shield and deal 195 DMG 3 times to all enemies. Each stack of 'Satiety' increases Exalt Base DMG and Shield Generation by 2%. Consume all 'Offering' stacks; each stack increases this skill's hit count by 1 and grants 1 stack of 'Satiety'.
skills.Buff Card — Blessing: Retain. Prepare. Gain 1 'Gift' with 1 'Price', and 1 stack of 'Offering'. Three types: Instant Blessing prevents 'Missed Chance'; Lavish Blessing prevents 'Gilded Words'; Tender Blessing prevents 'Veiled Malice'.
skills.Rouse (1) — Tempting Honeyfruit: Caraboo gains Aliemus equal to 50% of her Base Aliemus. After using 'Crimson Furnace', the next 'Miracle Blessing' costs -3 Arithmetica, and each Discover option is upgraded to a set containing 1 more 'Blessing' card. Choose 1 set to shuffle into your Draw Pile.
skills.Command (3) — Miracle Blessing: Gain 105 Shield. Discover 2 'Blessing' cards with different 'Prices'. Choose 1 to shuffle into your Draw Pile.
skills.Command (2) — Snowy Hex: Deal 10800 Fixed DMG to the enemy with the highest HP and inflict Weakness for 2 turns.

states.Satiety: Each stack increases Max HP by 10% of Caraboo's CON (max 50 stacks). At maximum stacks, excess stacks instead heal for 3× this HP value. Up to 10 stacks gainable per non-Boss battle. Persists between battles.
states.Offering: Consumed by Caraboo's Exalt to trigger bonus effects. Stacks up to 5. Persists between battles.

gifts: Temporarily reduce all enemies' STR by 105
prices: Missed Chance: delays the associated Gift by 2 turns
Gilded Words: reduces the associated Gift by 50%

Veiled Malice: inflicts 1 random negative effect on your team (2 turns Weakness; 2 turns Fragile; 2 turns Blighten; Poison equal to 1% Max HP; 2 stacks of Void; 1 stack of Stagnation on 2 random cards in hand; or 2 Temporary Symptom Cards on top of the Draw Pile)

enlightens.E1 — Secret Devotions: 'Snowy Hex' deals +30% Fixed DMG and grants 10 Aliemus. For every 1 point of Realm Mastery provided by Caraboo and her equipped WoD & Covenant, 'Snowy Hex' deals +0.15% Fixed DMG and grants +0.05 Aliemus.
enlightens.E2 — Sevenfold Rite: Every 7th time Caraboo plays 'Strike' or 'Defense', gain 1 stack of 'Offering' and Discover 2 'Blessing' cards with different 'Prices'. Choose 1 to add to your hand.
enlightens.E3 — Threefold Vow: Caraboo's Exalt DMG hits count +2. The Max HP bonus from each stack of 'Satiety' +50%. Exalt Base DMG and Shield Generation +50%.
enlightens.OE — Flawless Fairy Tale: Discover 2 sets of 'Blessing' cards with different 'Gifts', each set contains 2 cards. Choose 1 set to add to your hand. Reduce all enemies' STR by 14.
enlightens.AA — New Moon at Its Zenith: Rouse 'Tempting Honeyfruit' is enhanced. After using Crimson Furnace, the next 'Miracle Blessing' Discovers 1 additional 'Blessing' card per set. After playing a 'Blessing' card, Embryo Fusion +10. This fusion effect increases based on your lost HP, up to +100%.

signatureWheel.name: Honeyed Deceit
signatureWheel.effect: The wielder's Exalt generates +22/28/34/40% Base Shield. After the wielder plays a Command Card that inflicts Weakness, their next Command Card generates +22/28/34/40% Base Shield. Upon using 'Crimson Furnace', draw the wielder's Skill Card with the highest Arithmetica Cost and gain 22/28/34/40 Embryo Fusion. (Cooldown: 3 turns)

officialCorrections: Blessing cards also carry [Exhaust] — once played they are removed for the rest of combat and do not re-enter the deck. This was omitted from the skill preview graphic, so the Skills infographic alone is misleading.

Soulforge Aptitude: the English text 'Satiety increases Max HP by 10~100%' is WRONG. Correct reading is that the Max HP bonus provided by Satiety stacks is increased by +100%. Do not encode the infographic wording.
provisionalReadings: Reads as a shielder/sustain Warden with a strong Fixed DMG button, not a carry. Snowy Hex at 10800 Fixed DMG scaling off Realm Mastery via E1 is the damage, and both her signature wheel and her Realm Mastery stat line point the same way.
Likely teamRoles: shielder, healer, sub_dps. Likely synergyTags: embryo_gen (AA grants Embryo Fusion per Blessing), divine_realm.

The Blessing/Gift/Price system is a genuine risk-reward gamble with a randomised downside; the engine has no vocabulary for that today and it may not need one, but it is worth noting that her floor and ceiling are further apart than most.
Icefields terrain clause in Soulforge is the first terrain-conditional talent the annotations would need to express. Nothing in the engine models terrain.
